# iZiSwap

> iZiSwap, from iZUMi, is a concentrated-liquidity DEX with an on-chain order-book model, live on zkSync Era and other layer-2s. This page is a non-custodial interface: you connect your own wallet and sign every transaction. It explains concentrated pools, costs and safety checks.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- iZiSwap is a concentrated-liquidity DEX from the iZUMi project.
- It uses an on-chain order-book model alongside pooled liquidity.
- It is live on zkSync Era and other layer-2 networks.
- Costs are ETH gas plus pool fee tier and price impact shown in the quote.
- The interface is non-custodial and never holds funds or private keys.

## Pages

- iZiSwap & learn: https://iziswap-page.github.io/
- Legal: https://iziswap-page.github.io/legal.html
